composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the basket centered and filling about 70% of the square with even margins (at least 14% on every side). The basket is EMPTY and seen slightly from above so its open top is visible; the game piles small round bits into it at runtime, so the inside must be plain and uncluttered. No table, no cloth, no shadow outside the basket: it floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadow only inside the basket. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, the same material and lighting as the dish set and tray.
forbidden_objects: coloured dots, marks, gauges or icons other than the single front tag
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the basket
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the basket.
purpose: こんだてPLAY の状態 cue: トレーの手前に置かれた 3 つのかごの 1 つ（rice, bread and potatoes の仲間が集まるかご）。料理から飛んできた粒が中にたまる。三色食品群の言葉は使わず、前面の小さなタグの絵だけで何のかごか伝える
scene: a warm honey-yellow-tinted woven basket: a small, wide, low woven basket in the same miniature clay / toy style as the tray and dishes, empty, open top visible, with a small round tag on the front showing a simple rice-grain / bread-loaf silhouette (a simple embossed clay pictogram, no text). Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set.
